metadata.description: An explicit edge to dbx-cli:build-base, NOT `^build`. This entry point compiles into the parent's dist directory, which `dbx-cli:build-base` deletes and rewrites (rollup `deleteOutputPath: true`), so it cannot run before the parent -- but the edge has to be spelled out, because `^build` here would resolve to dbx-cli:build, which depends on this very target: a hard cycle. That XOR is the whole design constraint -- either the children get `^build` or the parent aggregates them, never both. Aggregating is the side that keeps one writer per dist directory.  Everything it imports in source (@dereekb/util, @dereekb/dbx-cli) arrives through the parent edge. Its package.json also lists @dereekb/firebase-server/test as a peerDependency with zero source usage; that false edge is suppressed with `implicitDependencies: ["!firebase-server-test"]` because declaring it would put firebase-server:build inside dbx-cli:build, and firebase-server -> zoho -> dbx-cli is a real project-graph path, so it closes a genuine task-graph cycle.
